title: $100M Offers
author: Alex Hormozi
whyInteresting: Centered on crafting offers so compelling that the value feels obvious and hard to refuse.
keyPromise: Improve pricing, packaging, and value articulation to create offers that convert more buyers.

title: Building a StoryBrand
author: Donald Miller
whyInteresting: Clarifies how to communicate a brand message so customers actually listen, using a proven storytelling framework.
keyPromise: Learn to cut through the noise and connect with customers by making them the hero of your story.

title: Crossing the Chasm
author: Geoffrey A. Moore
whyInteresting: A classic guide to taking disruptive products from early adopters to the mainstream market.
keyPromise: Learn how to position and sequence go-to-market efforts so innovative products can cross from niche traction to broad adoption.

title: Gap Selling
author: Keenan
whyInteresting: Focuses on diagnosing the gap between a buyer’s current state and desired future state before pitching a solution.
keyPromise: Sell more effectively by leading customer conversations around problems, impact, and business outcomes instead of product features.

title: Managing Oneself
author: Peter F. Drucker
whyInteresting: A concise guide to understanding your own strengths, values, and how you work best — essential for anyone trying to perform at their peak.
keyPromise: Discover how to place yourself where you can make the greatest contribution.

title: Oversubscribed
author: Daniel Priestley
whyInteresting: Explains how to create demand before launch so a product or service attracts buyers instead of chasing them.
keyPromise: Learn practical positioning and campaign ideas for building anticipation and becoming the obvious choice in a crowded market.

title: Pre-Suasion
author: Robert Cialdini
whyInteresting: Explores how to prepare your audience before delivering your message, so they are already primed to agree.
keyPromise: Master the art of channeling attention to make your message land before you even say it.

title: The Art of Thinking Clearly
author: Rolf Dobelli
whyInteresting: A catalogue of 99 cognitive biases and logical errors we make daily, with clear explanations to help avoid them.
keyPromise: Become aware of your mental blind spots and make significantly better decisions.

title: The Embedded Entrepreneur
author: Arvid Kahl
whyInteresting: Focuses on building a business from within an existing community by solving concrete problems for a clearly understood audience.
keyPromise: See how to find, validate, and grow a sustainable product business with direct customer insight from day one.

title: The Mom Test
author: Rob Fitzpatrick
whyInteresting: A practical handbook for customer conversations that reveal real problems instead of polite but misleading feedback.
keyPromise: Learn how to ask better questions so you can validate ideas with honest customer insight.
useCase: customer discovery, startup validation, user research

title: Value Proposition Design
author: Alex Osterwalder, Yves Pigneur, Greg Bernarda, Alan Smith
whyInteresting: Provides structured tools for matching products and services to real customer jobs, pains, and gains.
keyPromise: Design stronger offers by systematically aligning what you build with what customers actually value.

title: Yes!
author: Noah J. Goldstein, Steve J. Martin, Robert B. Cialdini
whyInteresting: 50 science-backed techniques for persuasion and influence, presented in short, actionable chapters.
keyPromise: Small, evidence-based changes to how you ask can dramatically increase compliance and cooperation.
